risks.risk: Whether it actually sews properly (stitching, tension, feed) and not just powers on.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video sewing a straight line on fabric (showing bobbin thread + top thread) and a close-up of stitch consistency.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully proven for sewing performance (worst case: needs adjustment/repair).

risks.risk: Motor/drive condition (smooth running claim not verifiable from a still photo).
risks.proof: Ask for a video of the machine running under load (pedal pressed) with sound and visible needle movement.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as motor/drive condition unknown (worst case: may be weak/noisy or intermittent).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or manual (seller claims included, but not shown).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo laid out of every accessory and the original manual (or a photo of the manual cover).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as accessories/manual not included (worst case: only machine + pedal/cable).

risks.risk: Condition issues not obvious in the photo (rust, worn gears, bent needle bar, cracked parts).
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of: needle area, bobbin/bottom plate, feed dogs, and any visible gear/drive area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible wear (worst case: may require parts/maintenance).

risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the plug and pedal label (if any) plus a quick test showing stable power without sparking/overheating.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as electrical condition unknown (worst case: needs cable/pedal replacement).

proof_requests: Video: machine sewing a straight seam on fabric (top + bobbin thread visible) with consistent stitches.
Video: pedal pressed showing needle movement and smooth operation (include sound).
Photos: all accessories laid out + original manual cover/page showing it matches the machine.
Close-ups: bobbin area/bottom plate, feed dogs, needle clamp/needle area, and any visible drive/gear parts.
response.reason: The machine identity (IDEAL TOPSTAR) is readable from the photo, but key value drivers—Japanese origin, smooth running, and whether accessories/manual are complete—are not verifiable from the single still image. To price confidently, request sewing-performance and accessory/manual proof.
